title: Kinase Interaction Network Expands Functional and Disease Roles of Human Kinases
model_system: Human HEK Flp-In 293 T-REx cells with single-locus doxycycline-induced N-terminal Strep-HA-tagged kinase baits; more than 100 million cells per purification, rapid single-step Strep affinity recovery, and duplicate LC-MS/MS runs. Final interactors required WD score > 73.6, GFP-control abundance ratio > 18.4, and at least two total spectra, followed by CRAPome, contaminant, and carry-over filters calibrated to a global false-positive rate below 1%.
experimentally_supported_claim: ABL2-bait AP-MS recovered CDC37 in the source's final high-confidence interaction matrix.
figure_or_table_anchors: Table S2 final interactome Excel row 1552: bait ABL2, prey CDC37, WD 208.86, GFP-control ratio 3417, total spectra 201; Table S4: bait not listed in the inherited Taipale comparison; Table S2 recovers HSP90AA1, HSP90AB1, and CDC37 with this bait; Table S9: target kinase construct matches canonical UniProt sequence
directness_boundary: Affinity purification-mass spectrometry supports cellular co-recovery or shared-complex membership, not purified binary binding.
negative_or_neutral_findings: No requested pair received reciprocal purification, western blot, BioID, genetic perturbation, or purified-protein validation in this study. experimentally_supported_claim: FKBP5-bait AP-MS recovered EIF2C1 above the source's SAINT AvgP 0.85 threshold.

negative_or_neutral_findings: No requested pair received a purified-protein binding test, regulatory direction test, pair-specific client-stability assay, or HSP90-isoform-resolved mediation test. title: OpenCell: proteome-scale endogenous tagging enables the cartography of human cellular organization
model_system: Human HEK293T polyclonal pools bearing CRISPR-generated endogenous split-mNeonGreen2 tags were lysed in 1.5% digitonin with Benzonase and captured using an anti-mNeonGreen nanobody. Each bait was analyzed in biological triplicate by label-free IP-MS. Interaction calls compared log2 LFQ measurements with bootstrapped null distributions built from an average of 349 unrelated tagged cell lines and used a bait-specific dynamic enrichment boundary. The released CSV contains accepted calls; its field named pval stores -log10(P), not a raw P value.
experimentally_supported_claim: The OpenCell accepted interaction release contains FKBP5->AGO1 as an endogenous-tag, triplicate cellular IP-MS association.
figure_or_table_anchors: Official processed interaction CSV line(s) 9118: native orientation FKBP5->AGO1; pval field -log10(P) 6.84348609945068; enrichment 2.49673094580221; interaction stoichiometry 0.00403153555500305; cellular-abundance stoichiometry 0.100077894286325; canonical AGO1; Taipale uses EIF2C1
directness_boundary: Endogenous-tag IP-MS measures association after lysis and can recover indirect members of larger complexes. It does not establish spatial proximity in vivo or purified binary contact. Bait-to-prey orientation is assay provenance rather than biological direction.
negative_or_neutral_findings: None of the 15 pairs passes both secondary core-cluster stoichiometry filters (interaction stoichiometry 0.05-10 and cellular-abundance stoichiometry 0.1-10). limitations: One transformed, pseudo-triploid HEK293T lineage; endogenous tags can still alter abundance, localization, or interfaces. Taipale 2014 is an independent source and method, but both studies use the 293T/HEK293T lineage. directness_boundary: The BioGRID 'Reconstituted Complex' route is rabbit-reticulocyte-lysate translation and mixing, not purified binary reconstitution; endogenous chaperones can remain. Each bait was analyzed in biological triplicate by label-free IP-MS. Interaction calls compared log2 LFQ measurements with bootstrapped null distributions built from an average of 349 unrelated tagged cell lines and used a bait-specific dynamic enrichment boundary. directness_boundary: Endogenous-tag IP-MS measures association after lysis and can recover indirect members of larger complexes. It does not establish spatial proximity in vivo or purified binary contact. Bait-to-prey orientation is assay provenance rather than biological direction.

The extreme interaction stoichiometry and blank abundance denominator are unsuitable for strength ranking; the missing reverse call is not evidence of absence.
limitations: One transformed, pseudo-triploid HEK293T lineage; endogenous tags can still alter abundance, localization, or interfaces. The split-fluorophore strategy mainly accesses nucleo-cytoplasmic proteins and cytosol-exposed membrane termini. Taipale 2014 is an independent source and method, but both studies use the 293T/HEK293T lineage. experimentally_supported_claim: FNIP2 is sufficient to increase FLCN abundance when overexpressed and, together with FNIP1, is required for full FLCN stability; FNIP2 also suppresses HSP90alpha ATPase activity, supporting a co-chaperone mechanism.
figure_or_table_anchors: Figure 4A-B,4D;Supplementary Figures 3A-B,4C-D
directness_boundary: The directed claim is FNIP2-to-FLCN protein-level support. A pair-specific full-length FNIP2 ternary loading reaction was not reconstituted, so the precise loading mechanism is less direct than for FNIP1.
negative_or_neutral_findings: Single FNIP2 depletion produced only a modest client decrease, whereas combined FNIP1/FNIP2 depletion was stronger.
limitations: Paralog compensation and combined depletion limit isoform-specific necessity; purified full-length FNIP2 was unavailable and cellular HSP90 paralog identity was unresolved.

title: Structural mechanism of a Rag GTPase activation checkpoint by the lysosomal folliculin complex
model_system: Purified recombinant human FLCN-FNIP2 and Rag-Ragulator complexes; 3.6-Angstrom cryo-EM; HEK293A and HEK293T nutrient-response and rescue assays
experimentally_supported_claim: FLCN and FNIP2 form a structurally resolved longin-longin and DENN-domain assembly within the lysosomal folliculin complex; reconstitution, SEC, mutagenesis, and GAP assays establish a stable state-dependent functional complex.
figure_or_table_anchors: Figures 1D-E,2D-F,4B-E,5D-F;Table S1
directness_boundary: The 3.6-Angstrom multicomponent cryo-EM reconstruction resolves an FLCN-FNIP2 interface, but it represents a defined Rag-Ragulator nucleotide state and includes disordered or homology-modeled regions rather than a binary affinity measurement.

limitations: The structure is a state-specific reconstituted multicomponent assembly; the study did not test HSP90 or HSP90 isoforms.

title: Galpha(12) and Galpha(13) interact with Ser/Thr protein phosphatase type 5 and stimulate its phosphatase activity
model_system: Constitutively active GNA12-Q229L bait screened a rat-brain yeast two-hybrid library. COS-7 assays tested tagged rat PPP5C full length, TPR domain, or phosphatase domain with wild-type or QL GNA12 by co-IP, GST pull-down from transfected lysate, microscopy, and fractionation. Reciprocal endogenous co-IP used adult rat-brain lysate. Defined cell-free phosphatase assays combined bacterially expressed GST-PPP5C with GST-GNA12 proteins.
experimentally_supported_claim: GNA12-QL bait recovered full-length PPP5C in yeast; GNA12 and PPP5C co-recovered in COS-7 cells and reciprocally from adult rat brain. GNA12 activation enhanced TPR-domain-dependent association, moved PPP5C from cytosol to the cell periphery/membrane, and increased purified GST-PPP5C phosphatase activity about 2.5-fold.
figure_or_table_anchors: Y2H Results: approximately 12 million rat-brain-library clones screened with GNA12-QL; Fig. 1B-C: three replicate GST-PPP5C-TPR pull-downs from COS-7 lysate and purified GST constructs; Fig. 2A: COS-7 co-IP of full-length/TPR but not phosphatase-domain PPP5C; Fig. 2B-C: reciprocal endogenous adult-rat-brain co-IP with anti-GNA12, anti-PPP5C, and anti-GNAQ control; Fig. 3 and Supplementary Fig. S1: activation-dependent PPP5C relocalization; Fig. 4A-C: defined GST-protein phosphatase assays
directness_boundary: The GST-PPP5C pull-down used transfected COS-7 lysate and does not establish purified binding. The defined purified-protein assay establishes direct functional activation under that assay, not a measured binding interface. The directed edge applies only to G-protein activation of PPP5C phosphatase activity; physical association remains undirected.
negative_or_neutral_findings: GST alone, GNAQ-QL, and GNAI2-QL did not bind PPP5C-TPR or activate PPP5C. PPP5C's isolated phosphatase domain did not co-IP with GNA12-QL or relocalize and was not activated. Anti-GNAQ did not recover endogenous PPP5C.
limitations: The constitutively active G-protein constructs and tagged proteins may not reproduce native stoichiometry. The authors note that HSP90 could mediate cellular GNA12-PPP5C association, but the source does not test HSP90 dependence or identify an HSP90 isoform. BioGRID and HPRD route labels aggregate this one paper and are not independent replication. These results are not HSP90 client evidence.

title: A quantitative chaperone interaction network reveals the architecture of cellular protein homeostasis pathways
model_system: Human stable polyclonal 293T cells expressing predominantly C-terminal 3xFLAG-V5-tagged chaperone or co-chaperone AP-MS baits were analyzed by anti-FLAG affinity-purification mass spectrometry from whole-cell lysate with sodium molybdate. Two AP-MS replicates were scored with SAINT; the high-confidence cutoff was AvgP >= 0.85 (estimated FDR 1.8%). LUMIER used transient 3xFLAG query baits and stable Renilla-fused reporter preys in 293T cells; normalized luminescence Z-scores were evaluated at the source's high-confidence cutoff of approximately 7 (estimated upper FDR 4.4%).
experimentally_supported_claim: PPID-bait AP-MS recovered source prey KIAA1704 above the source's SAINT AvgP 0.85 threshold; KIAA1704 maps to GPALPP1.
figure_or_table_anchors: Table S1 workbook, AvgP scores row 407: bait PPID, source prey KIAA1704, AvgP 1.00, Spec 50|90, CtrlCounts 0|0|0|0|0|0|0; KIAA1704 maps to GPALPP1 and was not an AP-MS bait; LUMIER scores row 596, KIAA1704-FLAG query with PPID-Renilla reporter, 1.310839
directness_boundary: Affinity-purification mass spectrometry from cellular lysate supports co-recovery or shared-complex membership, not purified binary binding. Bait-to-prey orientation records assay configuration rather than biological direction. Within-study replicate or reciprocal AP-MS does not establish HSP90 mediation, client status, or regulation.
negative_or_neutral_findings: No requested pair received a purified-protein binding test, regulatory direction test, pair-specific client-stability assay, functional perturbation, or HSP90-isoform-resolved mediation test. A database luminescence route represents a screened configuration and is counted as within-study cross-assay support only when the author's curated AP-MS-plus-LUMIER table passes both cutoffs. Reverse AP-MS was unavailable, and the measured LUMIER configuration failed the score 7 threshold.
limitations: The source uses tagged, expressed proteins in one transformed 293T lineage. Negative or missing LUMIER measurements do not disprove an association because assay sensitivity and construct configuration differ from AP-MS. The main text and combined sheet use LUMIER score >= 7, while the workbook information sheet says > 7; no requested measurement is near that boundary. BioGRID and IntAct records can project the same AP-MS or screened LUMIER configuration and are not independent source replications. IntAct's anti-tag coimmunoprecipitation label does not establish a separate pair-specific co-IP experiment.

title: Interaction of the Hsp90 cochaperone cyclophilin 40 with Hsc70
model_system: GST-CyP40/PPID retained cytosolic Hsp70/Hsc70 and recombinant rat Hsc70. Purified full-length rat Hsc70 and a GST-human CyP40 fragment supplied ELISA binding; human/bovine CyP40 constructs, human Hsp90beta, bacterial lysates, and bovine cytosol supplied mapping and competition context.
experimentally_supported_claim: Purified full-length rat Hsc70 bound a GST-human CyP40 fragment in ELISA, while CyP40 TPR/clamp mutations reduced binding. Lysate and recombinant-protein capture supported Hsp70/Hsc70 association; Hop competed, and Hsp90/Hsc70 binding to CyP40 was mutually exclusive.
figure_or_table_anchors: GST-CyP40 cytosol/recombinant capture; purified Hsc70-CyP40 ELISA; TPR/clamp mutant mapping; Hop and Hsp90 competition; trimer-exclusion experiments
directness_boundary: The purified assay supports direct HSPA8-PPID binding through the mammalian rat Hsc70 ortholog, not a same-species human HSPA8 preparation. This physical relation is undirected and does not establish regulation, client status, or HSP90 mediation.

experimentally_supported_claim: Supplementary Data 2, EPIC PPI row 23914, reports MCF10A, MCF7, and MDA-MB-231 scores 0.671;0.683;not_scored. With the source cutoff 0.625, the pair qualifies in MCF10A and MCF7.
figure_or_table_anchors: MOESM4 Supplementary Data 2, worksheet EPIC PPI, row 23914; EPIC cutoff 0.625
directness_boundary: Protein co-elution and classifier scoring support association or co-complex context only; they do not establish pairwise contact, stoichiometry, binding direction, or mechanism.
negative_or_neutral_findings: A displayed score below 0.625 or no score in another cell line is not a biological negative. The source provides no pair-specific perturbation or HSP90-dependence result.
limitations: The prediction can reflect membership in a larger assembly. Cell-line differences can reflect abundance or detectability. The table marks these pairs as overlapping BioGRID, so the source is an experimental re-detection/context observation rather than independent database corroboration.

title: Structural Basis of the Interaction between Tuberous Sclerosis Complex 1 (TSC1) and Tre2-Bub2-Cdc16 Domain Family Member 7 (TBC1D7)
relation_label: TBC1D7 directly binds a dimeric TSC1 C-terminal coiled-coil fragment through a predominantly hydrophobic interface
model_system: Recombinant human TSC1 residues 939-992 and TBC1D7 residues 19-293 expressed in bacteria; purified proteins; full-length tagged proteins in HEK293T
experimentally_supported_claim: At 3.10-Angstrom resolution, each TBC1D7 molecule contacts two parallel TSC1 helices through a largely hydrophobic interface. TSC1 I954, F958, I962 and TBC1D7 V94, V95, L114 substitutions strongly reduced or abolished binding in vitro, and full-length cellular co-IP provided orthogonal support.
figure_or_table_anchors: Figures 1-7;Tables 1-2;PDB 5EJC
directness_boundary: This directly resolves an isolated TSC1-TBC1D7 binding module and validates interface residues, but isolated-fragment oligomer ratios must not replace the mature 2:2:1 stoichiometry resolved in PMC7804450.
negative_or_neutral_findings: Isolated constructs could form 2 TSC1:1 TBC1D7 or 2:2 assemblies depending on concentration; this is not evidence that the mature holo-complex contains two TBC1D7 molecules.
limitations: The X-ray construct covers only TSC1 939-992 and near-full-length TBC1D7; isolated oligomer ratios are concentration-dependent, and mature-complex stoichiometry comes from PMC7804450.

title: Structural insights into TSC complex assembly and GAP activity on Rheb
relation_label: One TBC1D7 binds the C-terminal helices of the parallel TSC1 coiled-coil dimer in the mature 2:2:1 TSC complex
model_system: Full-length human TSC1, TSC2, and TBC1D7 coexpressed in Expi293F; purified GraFix-stabilized complex; HEK293A cell assays
experimentally_supported_claim: TBC1D7 directly associates with and stabilizes the terminal helices of both TSC1 chains at residues 937-971. The mature complex contains one TBC1D7 per TSC1 dimer and TSC2 dimer.
figure_or_table_anchors: Figure 1b-c;Figure 2b-f;Supplementary Figure 6f;PDB 7DL2;EMD-30708-30711
directness_boundary: The full-complex structure establishes TBC1D7-TSC1 contact. It shows no direct TBC1D7-TSC2 contact. The IntAct EM and co-IP rows and Complex Portal projection are encodings of the same source, not three replications.
negative_or_neutral_findings: TBC1D7 co-immunoprecipitated with TSC1 but not TSC2 in the source's pairwise test; this supports TSC1-mediated incorporation rather than a TBC1D7-TSC2 edge.
limitations: GraFix crosslinking; terminal or flexible regions limit atomic interpretation; this source does not establish a direct HSP90-TBC1D7 relationship.

title: Structural insights into TSC complex assembly and GAP activity on Rheb
relation_label: Two TSC1 chains form a parallel coiled-coil homodimer in the mature human TSC complex
model_system: Full-length human TSC1, TSC2, and TBC1D7 coexpressed in Expi293F; purified GraFix-stabilized complex
experimentally_supported_claim: The two TSC1 coiled-coil domains, residues 746-971, interwind in parallel as a two-turn left-handed supercoil with an approximately 2,386-square-Angstrom predominantly hydrophobic interface in the mature 2:2:1 TSC complex.
figure_or_table_anchors: Figure 2b-e;Supplementary Figure 5;PDB 7DL2;EMD-30708-30711
directness_boundary: This is direct native-complex structural evidence for TSC1 self-association. None of the four frozen v6.246 self-route records corresponds to this modern source; those older Y2H, FRET, and AP-MS records remain separate assay-context observations.
negative_or_neutral_findings: No contradictory native-complex finding. Some TSC1 sequence is flexible or poly-alanine modeled.
limitations: GraFix crosslinking was used; portions of TSC1 were unresolved or modeled as poly-alanine; this source does not assay self-dimerization outside the assembled complex or test HSP90.

title: Structure of the TBC1D7-TSC1 complex reveals that TBC1D7 stabilizes dimerization of the TSC1 C-terminal coiled coil region
relation_label: TSC1 residues 939-992 form a parallel coiled-coil dimer whose assembly is stabilized by TBC1D7
model_system: Recombinant human TSC1 residues 939-992 and TBC1D7 residues 21-293; purified proteins; HEK293T BiFC and colocalization; full-length complex purified from HEK293F
experimentally_supported_claim: At 2.81-Angstrom resolution, two TSC1 939-992 fragments form a parallel coiled-coil dimer in a 2:2 TBC1D7-TSC1 crystal assembly. Interface mutants disrupt binding or dimerization, and purified-protein, BiFC, and colocalization experiments show that TBC1D7 promotes or stabilizes TSC1 coiled-coil dimerization.
figure_or_table_anchors: Figures 1-6;Supplementary Figures S1-S6;Tables 1-2;PDB 4Z6Y
directness_boundary: This supports a direct TSC1 fragment dimer and a TBC1D7-dependent stabilization mechanism. The isolated 2:2 module is not the mature holo-complex stoichiometry, which is 2 TSC1:2 TSC2:1 TBC1D7 in PMC7804450.
negative_or_neutral_findings: TSC1 939-992 was predominantly monomeric without TBC1D7 under the isolated-fragment assay conditions; this does not contradict the full-length TSC1 dimer stabilized by the complete TSC complex.
limitations: The structure and solution measurements use C-terminal TSC1 fragments; BiFC can stabilize proximity; mitochondrial targeting is artificial; holo-complex stoichiometry comes from PMC7804450.

title: Structural insights into TSC complex assembly and GAP activity on Rheb
relation_label: TSC1 coiled-coil dimer makes multiple direct contacts with both TSC2 protomers in the 2:2:1 TSC complex
model_system: Full-length human TSC1, TSC2, and TBC1D7 coexpressed in Expi293F; purified GraFix-stabilized complex; HEK293A cell GAP assay
experimentally_supported_claim: The asymmetric human complex contains 2 TSC1:2 TSC2:1 TBC1D7. TSC1 residues 746-971 form a parallel dimer and contact both TSC2 protomers at several resolved interfaces, including TSC1a 800-890 on the TSC2 dimerization-domain saddle, TSC1a 746-795 against TSC2a HEAT7-12, the TSC1 890-936 dimer against TSC2b HEAT8-12, and TSC1a 937-971 against TSC2b HEAT3-7.
figure_or_table_anchors: Figure 1b-c;Figure 2b-f;Supplementary Figure 5;Supplementary Figure 6a-i;PDB 7DL2;EMD-30708-30711
directness_boundary: The cryo-EM model directly establishes physical contact. The two IntAct co-IP rows are duplicate encodings from this paper, and the Complex Portal row is complex membership rather than an additional independent experiment.
negative_or_neutral_findings: TSC1 bound TSC2 N-terminal HEAT constructs more clearly than isolated TSC2 dimerization or GAP domains; no finding contradicts the full-complex interface.
limitations: GraFix crosslinking was used; flexible regions were unresolved or modeled as poly-alanine; the structural experiment does not test HSP90 or HSP90 isoform specificity.

title: The HSP90/R2TP Quaternary Chaperone Scaffolds Assembly of the TSC Complex
relation_label: HSP90 and R2TP promote assembly and stability of the TSC1-TSC2 complex
model_system: HeLa GFP-TSC2 SILAC interactome; HEK293T LUMIER and abundance assays; PIH1D1 knockout; RUVBL1/2 ATPase inhibition
experimentally_supported_claim: GFP-TSC2 recovered HSP70, HSP90, and co-chaperones. Geldanamycin reduced reporter-tagged TSC1 and TSC2 abundance by about 40%. PIH1D1 loss reduced reciprocal TSC1-TSC2 LUMIER association by 28-34%, RUVBL1/2 inhibition reduced it by 73%, and combined perturbation reduced it by up to 90%.
figure_or_table_anchors: Figure 6B-C;Figure 7A-B;Figure 8;Supplementary Table S3
directness_boundary: This source supports HSP90/R2TP-dependent TSC-complex assembly but does not map the TSC1-TSC2 interface. Geldanamycin is broad and the HSP90 isoform is unresolved; pair directness comes from PMC7804450.
negative_or_neutral_findings: No negative TSC1-TSC2 result; TBC1D7 was not significantly recovered in the LUMIER configuration, so its R2TP dependence could not be tested.
limitations: Reporter and overexpression context; inhibitor selectivity and isoform ambiguity; HSP90 inhibition measured protein abundance rather than direct pair-contact loss; Supplementary Table S3 is not in the local package.

title: Dual proteome-scale networks reveal cell-specific remodeling of the human interactome
model_system: Human BioPlex 3 tagged-bait affinity-purification mass spectrometry in 293T cells.
experimentally_supported_claim: Official BioPlex directed and final-network matrices contain YWHAB to TSC1 with final-network pInt value(s) 0.99852225301501 in 293T.
figure_or_table_anchors: Official BioPlex 3 293T/HCT116 directed-edge and final-network matrices; exact gene-symbol rows
directness_boundary: Bait-to-prey is assay orientation rather than biological regulation. Tagged-bait AP-MS supports cellular or lysate co-recovery, not purified pairwise binding.
negative_or_neutral_findings: Absence from the other cell-line matrix is not biological negative evidence. The source supplies no pair-specific functional or HSP90-dependence result.
limitations: Tagged exogenous bait and cell-line context limit physiological generalization. BioGRID and IntAct routes from this PMID are projections of the same BioPlex experiment and are not independent evidence.
